recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a dead-man heartbeat check that the script pings on start and on clean exit, plus a top-level try/except that emails the user when the script crashes at startup, hosted either in an Uptime Kuma container on the Synology or on Healthchecks.io.
note: It rejects the central log and Docker plan but still recommends two alert mechanisms (the heartbeat and a crash email) and offers a self-hosted Uptime Kuma container, and none of the four labelled lines appear.
